g.data-flaw: Minor: the letterspaced list and venue now match, but the slab-condensed title is set in Bebas Neue and the ATTRACTIONS heading is left as original pixels.
g.data-outlook: Fixable: a slab-condensed display face in the corpus, and bands that stop at ornaments either side of a heading.
